Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Call invite for Quarter ended June 30, 2026 Results – Conference Call 
 
With reference to the above-mentioned subject, we wish to inform you that in relation to the Board meeting 
scheduled to be held on Friday, July 31, 2026 to consider and approve the un-audited standalone and 
consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, the management of Narayana 
Hrudayalaya Limited will host a conference call to discuss the Company’s performance on Monday, 
August 03, 2026 at 03:00 p.m. IST. 
 
Please find below the details of call invite: 
 
Link – https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=Wd9pR4Dx 
 
Kindly take the same on record. 
 
Thanking you 
 
Yours faithfully 
For Narayana Hrudayalaya Limited 
 
 
 
 
Sridhar S. 
Group Company Secretary, Legal & Compliance Officer
